tagline: Delivering mobility solutions across all segments with a portfolio spanning combustion engines, hybrids, and electric vehicles
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of vehicles delivered to customers is a key performance indicator for the company, reflecting demand and production capacity on a global scale.

kpis.name: Deliveries to customers
kpis.explanation: Number of vehicles delivered to customers
kpis.description: The total number of vehicles delivered to customers is a key performance indicator for the company
kpis.signal: Demand for vehicles of all types, including electric, is increasing

kpis.name: Sales revenue
kpis.signal: Sales revenue growth is driven by higher deliveries and favorable pricing

kpis.name: Operating result before special items
kpis.description: Operating result before special items reflects the group's operational performance
kpis.signal: Operating margin before special items remains stable despite macroeconomic challenges

kpis.name: Operating return on sales
kpis.explanation: Operating profitability as a percentage of sales revenue
kpis.description: Operating return on sales measures the group's operational efficiency
kpis.signal: Operating margin stabilizes at 7% despite fluctuations in raw material derivatives

kpis.name: R&D ratio
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a ratio of sales revenue
kpis.description: The R&D expense ratio reflects the group's commitment to innovation
kpis.signal: R&D investments remain steady, supporting the electric transition and technological innovation

kpis.name: Net cash flow
kpis.explanation: Net cash flow from the automotive division
kpis.description: Net cash flow from the automotive division reflects operational cash generation
kpis.signal: Net cash flow increases significantly, demonstrating the group's strong cash-generating ability

kpis.name: Net liquidity
kpis.explanation: Net liquidity of the automotive division
kpis.description: Net liquidity of the automotive division positions the group in a very strong financial position
kpis.signal: Net liquidity remains solid despite a slight decline due to strategic investments

kpis.name: Operating Result before Exceptional Items
kpis.description: Operating result before exceptional items reflects the group's operational performance
kpis.signal: Operating margin before exceptional items remains stable despite macroeconomic headwinds

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of EUR 6.3 in the last fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of EUR 4.46 Bn in the last fiscal year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 60.9% in the last fiscal year.
